title: Astra preserved a close RESECT point and repaired a larger displacement
claim: On two preselected public RESECT training points, one eligible Astra/medium attempt retained a 1.036 mm no-op point and reduced a 9.574 mm point error to 1.130 mm (88.2% reduction). Mean two-point error fell from 5.305 to 1.083 mm, and saved-output replay matched byte-for-byte.
limitations: Two selected public training cases and one eligible attempt; no population estimate, unseen-data claim or general model ranking.
Selection used evaluator-only tumor masks to choose one point per case before inference; the masks were not exposed to the solver.
The solver received both full volumes, their physical affines and the same-world no-op coordinate, then used visual reslicing plus exploratory local correlation.
Confidence values are subjective and uncalibrated; no independent clinical adjudication was performed.
The scalar Harbor reward checks artifact validity only and must not be read as scientific success.

2026-09-27 context audit: frozen Case B viewer example [-30,15,15] is 0.505444 mm from the private reference, closer than the returned 1.130199 mm point. Trace steps 5,18,19 prove delivery and candidate viewing; unaided correction and superiority to all supplied cues are unsupported. Example origin and causal impact remain unresolved.
